editorial_note_zh: 本期覆盖北京时间 2026 年 10 月 29 日至 31 日三个完整自然日，按首次公开时间筛选。10 月 31 日的机器人学高价值新增较少，主要入选内容来自 29 日和 30 日。论文均为预印本，实验结果来自作者报告；产业条目以机构公告为依据，其性能或部署效果尚未独立验证。
editorial_note_en: This three-day issue covers 29–31 October 2026 in Beijing time, using the first public release date. Few high-value robotics items qualified on 31 October; most selections were first disclosed on 29 or 30 October. Papers are preprints with author-reported results. Industry items rely on company announcements, and performance or deployment claims are not independently verified.

source_checks.title_zh: arXiv cs.RO：指定时间窗内无新投稿
source_checks.result_zh: 按北京时间 10 月 31 日换算为 UTC 10 月 30 日 16:00 至 10 月 31 日 15:59，检索 arXiv cs.RO 的首次投稿时间，API 返回 0 条。此结论仅针对该分类和该时间窗，不代表其他论文平台没有更新。
source_checks.result_en: The arXiv API returned zero cs.RO first submissions between 30 October 16:00 and 31 October 15:59 UTC, the Beijing reporting window. This check does not cover other repositories or journals.
